faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Staff.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DTU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated fellowship of Rs. 15,000 per month (inclusive of all allowances).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc./M.Tech. in Physics, Chemistry, Material Science, or a relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Net-Ph.D. only and non-net applicants are also eligible (as printed).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Selection is through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration: 1 Year. Position is under the DST-INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship project sponsored by DST, Government of India.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department of Applied Physics, Delhi Technological University, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Updated CV; Original educational certificates; Experience certificates (if any); One set of self-attested photocopies of relevant documents.
